mapper.sql: t.id, t.task_no AS taskNo, t.cycle_id AS cycleId, t.cycle_case_id AS cycleCaseId, t.parent_task_id AS parentTaskId, t.task_type AS taskType, t.task_status AS taskStatus, t.requested_by AS requestedBy, t.executor, t.retry_count AS retryCount, t.heartbeat_at AS heartbeatAt, t.started_at AS startedAt, t.completed_at AS completedAt, t.error_message AS errorMessage, t.created_at AS createdAt, tc.cycle_no AS cycleNo, tc.cycle_name AS cycleName, tc.code_version AS codeVersion, v.version_no AS versionNo, p.project_name AS projectName, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tc.environment_snapshot, '$.environmentName')), e.environment_name) AS environmentName, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tc.environment_snapshot, '$.environmentCode')), e.environment_code) AS environmentCode, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tc.environment_snapshot, '$.environmentType')), e.environment_type) AS environmentType

FROM dpm_execution_task t INNER JOIN dpm_test_cycle tc ON tc.id = t.cycle_id INNER JOIN dpm_version v ON v.id = tc.version_id INNER JOIN dpm_project p ON p.id = v.project_id INNER JOIN dpm_environment e ON e.id = tc.environment_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1)
mapper.sql:
FROM dpm_execution_task t INNER JOIN dpm_test_execution x ON x.id = ( SELECT x2.id FROM dpm_test_execution x2 WHERE x2.task_id = t.id ORDER BY x2.attempt_no DESC, x2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) INNER JOIN dpm_test_cycle tc ON tc.id = t.cycle_id INNER JOIN dpm_version v ON v.id = tc.version_id INNER JOIN dpm_project p ON p.id = v.project_id INNER JOIN dpm_cycle_case cc ON cc.id = t.cycle_case_id
AND t.task_type = 'EXECUTE_CASE' AND x.runner_type = 'CHATGPT' AND x.execution_mode = 'AI' AND t.task_status = #{status} AND x.result = #{result}
AND (t.task_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR tc.cycle_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cc.case_snapshot, '$.caseNo')) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND x.attempt_no > 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dpm_test_execution interrupted WHERE interrupted.task_id = t.id AND interrupted.execution_status = 'INTERRUPTED' )
mapper.select:
SELECT t.id AS taskId, t.task_no AS taskNo, t.task_status AS taskStatus, t.cycle_id AS cycleId, tc.cycle_name AS cycleName, p.project_name AS projectName, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cc.case_snapshot, '$.caseNo')) AS caseNo, x.id AS executionId, x.attempt_no AS attemptNo, x.execution_status AS executionStatus, x.result, CASE WHEN x.checkpoint_json IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS hasCheckpoint, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dpm_execution_event ev WHERE ev.execution_id = x.id) AS eventCount, t.created_at AS createdAt
ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(1)

SELECT tc.id, tc.status, tc.version_id AS versionId, tc.code_version AS codeVersion, tc.environment_id AS environmentId, CAST(tc.environment_snapshot AS CHAR) AS environmentSnapshotJson, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tc.environment_snapshot, '$.environmentType')), e.environment_type) AS environmentType, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tc.environment_snapshot, '$.environmentCode')), e.environment_code) AS environmentCode FROM dpm_test_cycle tc INNER JOIN dpm_environment e ON e.id = tc.environment_id WHERE tc.id = #{cycleId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT cycle_id FROM dpm_execution_task WHERE id = #{taskId}
SELECT id FROM dpm_execution_task WHERE cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND parent_task_id IS NULL AND task_status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','WAITING_HUMAN','RECOVERY_REQUIRED') ORDER BY created_at, id

SELECT id, cycle_id AS cycleId, cycle_case_id AS cycleCaseId, parent_task_id AS parentTaskId, task_type AS taskType, task_status AS taskStatus, retry_count AS retryCount FROM dpm_execution_task WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, cycle_case_id AS cycleCaseId, task_type AS taskType FROM dpm_execution_task WHERE cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1

SELECT cc.id AS cycleCaseId, cc.cycle_id AS cycleId, cc.test_case_id AS testCaseId, cc.execution_mode AS executionMode, CAST(cc.case_snapshot AS CHAR) AS caseSnapshotJson, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cc.case_snapshot, '$.expectedResult')) AS expectedResult, cr.script_revision_id AS scriptRevisionId, sr.script_language AS scriptLanguage, sr.script_version AS scriptVersion, sr.runtime_version AS scriptRuntimeVersion, sr.source_type AS scriptSourceType, sr.source_path AS scriptSourcePath, sr.source_content AS scriptSourceContent, sr.entry_point AS scriptEntryPoint, CAST(sr.arguments_json AS CHAR) AS scriptArgumentsJson FROM dpm_cycle_case cc LEFT JOIN dpm_test_case_revision cr ON cr.id = cc.test_case_revision_id LEFT JOIN dpm_test_script_revision sr ON sr.id = cr.script_revision_id WHERE cc.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND cc.id = #{cycleCaseId} ORDER BY cc.sequence_no, cc.id FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dpm_execution_task WHERE cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND parent_task_id IS NULL AND task_status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','WAITING_HUMAN','RECOVERY_REQUIRED')

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dpm_execution_task WHERE cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND task_type = 'EXECUTE_CYCLE' AND parent_task_id IS NULL AND task_status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','WAITING_HUMAN','RECOVERY_REQUIRED')

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dpm_execution_task WHERE cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND cycle_case_id = #{cycleCaseId} AND parent_task_id IS NULL AND task_status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','WAITING_HUMAN','RECOVERY_REQUIRED')
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO dpm_execution_task (task_no, idempotency_key, cycle_id, cycle_case_id, parent_task_id, task_type, task_status, requested_by, request_payload) VALUES (#{taskNo}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{cycleId}, #{cycleCaseId}, #{parentTaskId}, #{taskType}, #{taskStatus}, #{requestedBy},
CAST(#{requestPayloadJson} AS JSON) NULL )

INSERT INTO dpm_test_execution (cycle_case_id, task_id, attempt_no, execution_mode, runner_type, trigger_source, execution_status, expected_result_snapshot, request_snapshot, checkpoint_json) VALUES (#{cycleCaseId}, #{taskId}, #{attemptNo}, #{executionMode}, #{runnerType}, #{triggerSource}, #{executionStatus}, #{expectedResultSnapshot},
CAST(#{requestSnapshotJson} AS JSON) NULL ,
CAST(#{checkpointJson} AS JSON) NULL )

INSERT INTO dpm_execution_event (execution_id, event_type, event_key, event_content, event_data, created_by) VALUES (#{executionId}, #{eventType}, #{eventKey}, #{eventContent},
CAST(#{eventDataJson} AS JSON) NULL , #{createdBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id

INSERT INTO dpm_execution_attachment (execution_id, attachment_type, file_name, relative_path, mime_type, file_size, sha256, created_by) VALUES (#{executionId}, #{attachmentType}, #{fileName}, #{relativePath}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{sha256}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, execution_id AS executionId, attachment_type AS attachmentType, file_name AS fileName, mime_type AS mimeType, file_size AS fileSize, sha256, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt FROM dpm_execution_attachment WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, execution_id AS executionId, attachment_type AS attachmentType, file_name AS fileName, relative_path AS relativePath, mime_type AS mimeType, file_size AS fileSize, sha256, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt FROM dpm_execution_attachment WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT , t.parent_task_id AS parentTaskId, CAST(t.request_payload AS CHAR) AS requestPayloadJson, CAST(t.result_payload AS CHAR) AS resultPayloadJson, t.retry_count AS retryCount
WHERE t.id = #{id}

SELECT t.id, t.task_no AS taskNo, t.cycle_case_id AS cycleCaseId, t.task_type AS taskType, t.task_status AS taskStatus, t.requested_by AS requestedBy, t.executor, t.retry_count AS retryCount, t.started_at AS startedAt, t.completed_at AS completedAt, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cc.case_snapshot, '$.caseNo')) AS caseNo, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cc.case_snapshot, '$.title')) AS caseTitle FROM dpm_execution_task t LEFT JOIN dpm_cycle_case cc ON cc.id = t.cycle_case_id WHERE t.parent_task_id = #{parentTaskId} ORDER BY t.created_at, t.id

SELECT t.id, t.task_no AS taskNo, t.cycle_case_id AS cycleCaseId, t.task_type AS taskType, t.task_status AS taskStatus, t.requested_by AS requestedBy, t.executor, t.retry_count AS retryCount FROM dpm_execution_task t WHERE t.parent_task_id = #{parentTaskId} ORDER BY t.created_at, t.id FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, cycle_case_id AS cycleCaseId, task_id AS taskId, attempt_no AS attemptNo, execution_mode AS executionMode, runner_type AS runnerType, trigger_source AS triggerSource, execution_status AS executionStatus, result, executor_name AS executorName, expected_result_snapshot AS expectedResultSnapshot, actual_result AS actualResult, CAST(request_snapshot AS CHAR) AS requestSnapshotJson, CAST(response_snapshot AS CHAR) AS responseSnapshotJson, generated_script_language AS generatedScriptLanguage, log_excerpt AS logExcerpt, human_intervention_required AS humanInterventionRequired, human_intervention_status AS humanInterventionStatus, human_intervention_note AS humanInterventionNote, error_message AS errorMessage, started_at AS startedAt, completed_at AS completedAt, duration_ms AS durationMs, CAST(checkpoint_json AS CHAR) AS checkpointJson, created_at AS createdAt FROM dpm_test_execution WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY attempt_no DESC

SELECT id, execution_id AS executionId, event_type AS eventType, event_key AS eventKey, event_content AS eventContent, CAST(event_data AS CHAR) AS eventDataJson, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt FROM dpm_execution_event WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} ORDER BY id

SELECT x.id, x.task_id AS taskId, x.cycle_case_id AS cycleCaseId, x.attempt_no AS attemptNo, x.execution_mode AS executionMode, x.runner_type AS runnerType, x.execution_status AS executionStatus, x.result, x.expected_result_snapshot AS expectedResultSnapshot, CAST(x.request_snapshot AS CHAR) AS requestSnapshotJson, CAST(x.checkpoint_json AS CHAR) AS checkpointJson FROM dpm_test_execution x WHERE x.task_id = #{taskId} AND x.id = #{executionId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT x.id, x.task_id AS taskId, x.cycle_case_id AS cycleCaseId, x.attempt_no AS attemptNo, x.execution_mode AS executionMode, x.runner_type AS runnerType, x.trigger_source AS triggerSource, x.execution_status AS executionStatus, x.result, x.expected_result_snapshot AS expectedResultSnapshot, CAST(x.request_snapshot AS CHAR) AS requestSnapshotJson, CAST(x.checkpoint_json AS CHAR) AS checkpointJson FROM dpm_test_execution x WHERE x.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY x.attempt_no DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, cycle_id AS cycleId, cycle_case_id AS cycleCaseId, parent_task_id AS parentTaskId FROM dpm_execution_task WHERE task_type = 'EXECUTE_CASE' AND task_status = 'RUNNING' AND ((lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at <= NOW()) OR (lease_owner IS NULL AND heartbeat_at IS NOT NULL AND heartbeat_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE))) ORDER BY COALESCE(lease_expires_at, heartbeat_at) LIMIT 100

SELECT t.id, x.id AS executionId FROM dpm_execution_task t INNER JOIN dpm_test_execution x ON x.id = ( SELECT x2.id FROM dpm_test_execution x2 WHERE x2.task_id = t.id ORDER BY x2.attempt_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) INNER JOIN dpm_test_cycle tc ON tc.id = t.cycle_id INNER JOIN dpm_environment e ON e.id = tc.environment_id WHERE tc.status = 'RUNNING' AND t.task_type = 'EXECUTE_CASE' AND t.task_status = 'PENDING' AND x.execution_mode = 'AI' AND x.runner_type = 'CHATGPT' AND x.execution_status = 'QUEUED' AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tc.environment_snapshot, '$.environmentType')), e.environment_type) <> 'PROD' ORDER BY t.created_at, t.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.id, t.parent_task_id AS parentTaskId FROM dpm_execution_task t INNER JOIN dpm_test_execution x ON x.id = ( SELECT x2.id FROM dpm_test_execution x2 WHERE x2.task_id = t.id ORDER BY x2.attempt_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) INNER JOIN dpm_test_cycle tc ON tc.id = t.cycle_id INNER JOIN dpm_environment e ON e.id = tc.environment_id WHERE tc.status = 'RUNNING' AND t.task_type = 'EXECUTE_CASE' AND t.task_status = 'PENDING' AND x.execution_status = 'QUEUED' AND x.runner_type = #{runnerType} AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tc.environment_snapshot, '$.environmentType')), e.environment_type) <> 'PROD' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(x.request_snapshot, '$.scriptSnapshot.language')) = #{runnerType} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(x.request_snapshot, '$.scriptSnapshot.sourceType')) = 'INLINE' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(x.request_snapshot, '$.scriptSnapshot.sourceContent')) = 'STRING' ORDER BY t.created_at, t.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(attempt_no), 0) + 1 FROM dpm_test_execution WHERE cycle_case_id = #{cycleCaseId}
mapper.update: UPDATE dpm_cycle_case SET execution_status = #{status}, latest_result = COALESCE(#{result}, latest_result) WHERE id = #{cycleCaseId}

UPDATE dpm_test_cycle SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = COALESCE(completed_at, NOW()) WHERE id = #{cycleId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dpm_cycle_case cc WHERE cc.cycle_id = dpm_test_cycle.id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dpm_cycle_case cc WHERE cc.cycle_id = dpm_test_cycle.id AND cc.execution_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED') )

UPDATE dpm_execution_task SET task_status = 'RUNNING', executor = #{executor}, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, NOW()), heartbeat_at = NOW(), completed_at = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND task_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE dpm_execution_task SET task_status = 'RUNNING', executor = #{runnerId}, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, NOW()), heartbeat_at = NOW(), lease_owner = #{runnerId}, lease_token_hash = #{leaseTokenHash}, lease_expires_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), completed_at = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND task_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE dpm_execution_task SET heartbeat_at = NOW(), lease_expires_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND) WHERE id = #{id} AND task_status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{runnerId} AND lease_token_hash = #{leaseTokenHash} AND lease_expires_at > NOW()

UPDATE dpm_execution_task SET task_status = 'FAILED', completed_at = NOW(), heartbeat_at = NOW(), error_message = #{errorMessage}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_token_hash = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND task_status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{runnerId} AND lease_token_hash = #{leaseTokenHash} AND lease_expires_at > NOW()

UPDATE dpm_test_execution SET execution_status = 'RUNNING', executor_name = #{executorName}, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, NOW()), error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND execution_status = 'QUEUED'
UPDATE dpm_execution_task SET heartbeat_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND task_status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE dpm_test_execution SET execution_status = 'WAITING_HUMAN', human_intervention_required = 1, human_intervention_status = 'WAITING', human_intervention_note = #{note} WHERE id = #{id} AND execution_status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE dpm_execution_task SET task_status = 'WAITING_HUMAN', lease_owner = NULL, lease_token_hash = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND task_status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE dpm_test_execution SET checkpoint_json = CAST(#{checkpointJson} AS JSON) WHERE id = #{id} AND execution_status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE dpm_test_execution SET execution_status = 'COMPLETED', result = #{result}, actual_result = #{actualResult}, log_excerpt = #{logExcerpt}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_at = NOW(), duration_ms = IF(started_at IS NULL, NULL, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, started_at, NOW()) DIV 1000) WHERE id = #{id} AND execution_status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE dpm_test_execution SET execution_status = 'COMPLETED', result = 'BLOCKED', actual_result = #{note}, human_intervention_status = 'REJECTED', human_intervention_note = #{note}, completed_at = NOW(), duration_ms = IF(started_at IS NULL, NULL, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, started_at, NOW()) DIV 1000) WHERE id = #{id} AND execution_status = 'WAITING_HUMAN'

UPDATE dpm_execution_task SET task_status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = NOW(), heartbeat_at = NOW(), lease_owner = NULL, lease_token_hash = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND task_status IN ('RUNNING','WAITING_HUMAN')

UPDATE dpm_test_execution SET execution_status = 'CANCELLED', error_message = #{note}, completed_at = NOW(), duration_ms = IF(started_at IS NULL, NULL, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, started_at, NOW()) DIV 1000) WHERE id = #{executionId} AND execution_status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING_HUMAN','INTERRUPTED')

UPDATE dpm_execution_task SET task_status = 'CANCELLED', cancel_requested_at = NOW(), completed_at = NOW(), lease_owner = NULL, lease_token_hash = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND task_status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','WAITING_HUMAN','RECOVERY_REQUIRED')

UPDATE dpm_test_execution SET execution_status = 'QUEUED', human_intervention_status = 'CONFIRMED', human_intervention_note = #{note}, human_intervention_required = 0 WHERE id = #{id} AND execution_status = 'WAITING_HUMAN'

UPDATE dpm_execution_task SET task_status = 'PENDING', executor = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, completed_at = NULL, error_message = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_token_hash = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND task_status IN ('WAITING_HUMAN','RECOVERY_REQUIRED')

UPDATE dpm_execution_task SET task_status = 'PENDING', executor = NULL, retry_count = retry_count + 1, heartbeat_at = NULL, completed_at = NULL, error_message = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_token_hash = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND task_status = 'RECOVERY_REQUIRED'

UPDATE dpm_test_execution SET execution_status = 'INTERRUPTED', error_message = #{note}, completed_at = NOW(), duration_ms = IF(started_at IS NULL, NULL, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, started_at, NOW()) DIV 1000) WHERE id = #{id} AND execution_status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE dpm_execution_task SET task_status = 'RECOVERY_REQUIRED', error_message = #{note}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_token_hash = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND task_status = 'RUNNING' AND ((lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at <= NOW()) OR (lease_owner IS NULL AND heartbeat_at IS NOT NULL AND heartbeat_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)))

UPDATE dpm_execution_task SET task_status = #{status}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED') THEN COALESCE(completed_at,NOW()) ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{id} AND task_type = 'EXECUTE_CYCLE'
mapper.select: SELECT parent_task_id FROM dpm_execution_task WHERE id = #{id}
